traditional: Sun sextile the Moon: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports vitality, authority, and recognition - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity and emotion, the outer self and the inner life. How who you present yourself to be lines up (or doesn't) with what you actually feel and need. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Outer and inner self move easily together. Steady, consistent, at ease with oneself, though it can lack a charge of its own. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize feeling and selfhood into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what feeling and selfhood have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and egotism and needing to be the center go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: A policy change is announced early enough for someone to catch the detail that would have created a much bigger problem later. The sextile between the Sun and Moon can create room for an official decision to adjust to the people who actually have to live with it. A grace period, transit option, childcare plan, or revised start date may be enough to keep one rule from derailing an entire week. Use the lead time. Ask who will have to rearrange the most before the policy is locked, then fix the preventable problem while the plan can still move.
